geometry: Original native Y PLC plus original V3 analytic height law; fixed shared PLC for both meshes, no smoothing/hull

mesh.refinement_scope: Same PLC, volume refinement in local sphere; surface already <=50um near clot before radial displacement. No geometry refinement in second solve.

flow.outlets: Original Neu, steady Value=0; zero traction, not pointwise p=0
flow.time_integrator: Original generalized alpha spectral radius .5; transient to steady
flow.backend: Existing validated GPU PETSc options + CPU domain decomposition; unchanged native solver

criteria.no_symmetry_gate: Clot breaks symmetry; measure outlet fractions

mesh_comparison.contact_rim: Faces centroid within100um of contact line reported separately; peaks diagnostic, never finite peak convergence assertion

traction.gradient: Piecewise linear tetrahedral velocity gradient from adjacent native volume element
traction.pressure: P1 face mean, gauge relative to original zero-traction outlets
traction.integration: Actual exposed CFD triangles only; pressure linear integrated exactly, viscous piecewise constant; split pressure, normal/tangential viscous, total; moments use degree2 triangle quadrature

budgets.stop: No second solve unless baseline mesh and all CFD criteria pass
